description: Conteo Ciclovia is a dataset listed in City of Montevideo open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Departamento de Movilidad. El sistema de conteo automático de bicicletas implementado en una intersección urbana se basa en redes neuronales convolucionales (CNNs) optimizadas mediante el algoritmo YOLO (You Only Look Once), lo que permite la detección y el seguimiento en tiempo real. Coverage: Montevideo. The portal files it under the publisher Departamento de Movilidad. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is dag-uy. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mvd-portal.
